content.introduction: Your safety is our priority. Learn about campus safety resources and how to stay safe on and around campus.

sections.title: Campus Police
sections.content:
Contact Information:
- Emergency: 911 or (555) 123-4500
- Non-Emergency: (555) 123-4501
- Anonymous Tip Line: (555) 123-4599

Services:
- 24/7 patrol and response
- Crime prevention programs
- Safety escorts
- Vehicle assistance
- Lost and found

Location: Safety Building, 50 Campus Drive

sections.title: Safety Escort Program
sections.content:
Free walking escorts:
- Available 7PM to 3AM daily
- Anywhere on campus
- To nearby off-campus locations

How to Request:
1. Call (555) 123-4505
2. Use SafeWalk app
3. Request at any blue light phone

Wait in safe, well-lit area for escort.

sections.title: Emergency Notifications
sections.content:
How to Enroll:
1. Log into Student Portal
2. Go to Personal Information
3. Update emergency contacts
4. Confirm cell phone number
5. Enable text notifications

Notifications Include:
- Campus emergencies
- Weather closures
- Security threats
- Building evacuations

sections.title: Personal Safety Tips
sections.content:
On Campus:
- Stay aware of surroundings
- Use well-lit paths at night
- Lock doors and windows
- Don't prop doors open
- Report suspicious activity

At Social Events:
- Go with friends, leave with friends
- Watch your drink
- Have a check-in plan
- Know your limits
- Use safe transportation

sections.title: Reporting Incidents
sections.content:
If You're a Victim:
- Get to safety first
- Call for help
- Preserve evidence if possible
- Seek medical attention
- Report to appropriate office

Anonymous Reporting:
- Silent Witness form
- Anonymous tip line

Support Resources:
- Victim Advocate Office
- Counseling Center
- Title IX Office

content.conclusion: Safety is everyone's responsibility. Stay alert, look out for each other, and don't hesitate to report concerns.
